projects.useCase: Explore protein sequence representations with reproducible, family-colored projections.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.value: Sequence and family columns in a CSV file

workflow.label: Process
workflow.value: Protein language model embeddings → t-SNE / UMAP

workflow.label: Output
workflow.value: Embeddings, linked records, model metadata, and PNG/SVG plots

example.imageAlt: UMAP projection of 7,757 protein embeddings from Biohub/ESMC-600M, colored by the first EC digit.

projects.title: Visualize_prtebd
projects.description: Generate traceable protein embeddings with Hugging Face protein language models and visualize them with t-SNE and UMAP.
highlights: Supports ESMC, ESM-2, ProtT5, and custom Hugging Face checkpoints.
Exports embeddings, source-linked records, and model metadata.
Produces reproducible PNG/SVG plots and dimensionality-reduction coordinates.

projects.useCase: Find a starting point for choosing an enzyme kinetic parameter prediction model.

workflow.label: Choose
workflow.value: A target parameter: kcat, Km, or kcat/Km

workflow.label: Browse
workflow.value: Models grouped by parameter, with publication years

workflow.label: Follow up
workflow.value: Read the linked paper and public implementation when available

example.label: Example lookup
example.caption: Looking for a Km predictor? Start in the Km section, compare publication years, then follow the paper and implementation links to check the method against your data.

projects.title: PEKP
projects.description: Collect models for predicting enzyme kinetic parameters in one compact, parameter-organized reference.
highlights: Groups model links into kcat, Km, and kcat/Km sections.
Records the publication year alongside each model.
Includes links to public implementations and papers when available.

projects.useCase: Learn Japanese from the beginning with Chinese explanations and daily practice on a desktop computer.

workflow.label: Set up
workflow.value: Add a Chat Completions-compatible AI service and model in Preferences

workflow.label: Learn
workflow.value: Generate a daily lesson with kana, vocabulary, examples, listening, and exercises

workflow.label: Review
workflow.value: Revisit saved lessons and flashcards, then explore grammar and JLPT practice

example.label: First lesson walkthrough
example.caption: Choose the first Daily Lesson and select AI Create Lesson. Study the generated material, then save flashcards for later offline review.

projects.title: Haru
projects.description: A desktop Japanese-learning app for Chinese speakers, with AI-generated lessons, flashcards, grammar explanations, and reading practice.
highlights: Creates daily lessons covering kana, vocabulary, example sentences, listening, and exercises.
Includes flashcards, a grammar decoder, JLPT N5–N1 practice, and Japanese stories.
Keeps saved lessons and flashcards available for offline review.
